heading, “Patients feel that both they and the GP are more present during the consultation.”, level 3
GP Partner, NHS St Wulfstan Surgery
Tandem generates clinical documents from your consultations in seconds. It suggests relevant diagnosis and procedure codes, such as ICD-10 and SNOMED, and includes hands-free voice editing.
heading, Auto-create referrals, sick notes, and more, level 6
Clinical documents are instantly generated from the consultation, including referrals, sick notes, and visit summaries, ready to review and complete.
heading, Find your codes effortlessly, level 6
Relevant codes automatically appear right next to the note, making them easy to review and select immediately.
heading, Edit using your voice, level 6
Edit notes simply by using your voice. Tandem applies structure and formatting automatically. Like having a personal assistant that's always available.

heading, Complies with local patient data laws, level 6
Tandem Health complies with GDPR, ISO 13485, ISO 27001, and NHS DSPT requirements, supporting secure and compliant data handling.
heading, All data stored and processed within the EU, level 6
All patient data is processed and stored in data centres within Europe. Tandem has enterprise agreements in place to maintain compliance and strict security standards.
Tandem never stores conversation audio. All audio is deleted after the transcription is completed
heading, MDR Class IIa certified medical devices, level 6
